# Helper to paginate phone search_contacts
def phone_search_all(query, relationship=None, page_limit=20):
    results=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=query, relationship=relationship, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('phone page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return results

person_emails = {}
for name, amt in I_owe + owes_me:
    print('--- Searching friend contacts for', name)
    contacts = phone_search_all(query=name, relationship='friend')
    print('total friend contacts matched', name, len(contacts))
    # take those where first or last name matches case-insensitive exactly or contains
    if contacts:
        # score exact match on first_name/last_name
        name_l = name.lower()
        scored=[]
        for c in contacts:
            fn=(c.get('first_name') or '').lower()
            ln=(c.get('last_name') or '').lower()
            score=0
            if fn==name_l: score+=3
            if ln==name_l: score+=2
            if fn.startswith(name_l) or ln.startswith(name_l): score+=1
            if score==0: score=0
            scored.append((score,c))
        scored.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0], x[1].get('email','')))
        best=scored[0][1]
        print('best contact', best.get('first_name'), best.get('last_name'), best.get('email'))
        person_emails[name]=best.get('email')
    else:
        print('no friend contacts found for', name)
print('person_emails', person_emails)

owes_me = [('Robert', 143.0), ('Cesar', 149.0), ('Carl', 81.0)]
person_emails = {'Paul': 'paul_mill@gmail.com', 'Gina': 'gina-ritter@gmail.com', 'Cheryl': 'cheweber@gmail.com', 'Bradley': 'bradley_ball@gmail.com', 'Robert': 'robertmartinez@gmail.com', 'Cesar': 'ce-maldonado@gmail.com', 'Carl': 'carbrown@gmail.com'}

created_transactions = []
for name, amt in I_owe:
    receiver_email = person_emails[name]
    res = apis.venmo.create_transaction(receiver_email=receiver_email, amount=amt, access_token=venmo_token, description='For Athens trip', private=True)

    created_transactions.append({'name': name, 'email': receiver_email, 'amount': amt, 'transaction_id': res.get('transaction_id')})

created_payment_requests = []
for name, amt in owes_me:
    user_email = person_emails[name]
    res = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(user_email=user_email, amount=amt, access_token=venmo_token, description='For Athens trip', private=True)
    print('request from', name, user_email, 'amt', amt, '=>', res)
    created_payment_requests.append({'name': name, 'email': user_email, 'amount': amt, 'payment_request_id': res.get('payment_request_id')})

print('created_transactions', created_transactions)
